groupings.title: Capture your voice
groupings.description: Turn your own sent mail and chats into a measured, private profile of how you actually write - no adjectives, just your numbers, openers, sign-offs and never-list.

groupings.title: Write and verify
groupings.description: Draft replies, emails and posts that read like you wrote them, then prove it with a deterministic check that catches length inflation, wrong sign-offs, AI-default phrases and self-parody.

groupings.title: Keep it yours
groupings.description: Log what you actually sent instead of the draft, surface the corrections that keep recurring, and promote them into rules only when you say so.
